era: 1936 年生于秘鲁阿雷基帕（中产家庭，父母离异，幼年在玻利维亚科恰班巴与秘鲁皮乌拉度过）——少年在利马莱昂西奥·普拉多军事学校就读，这段经历成为《城市与狗》的原型——1950 年代在圣马科斯大学读法律与文学，同时以记者身份为多家报纸写稿，与'胡莉娅姨妈'的婚姻成为《胡莉娅姨妈与作家》的素材——1958 年首次赴巴黎，此后长住欧洲（巴黎、伦敦、巴塞罗那），在'拉丁美洲的国外'完成对秘鲁的回望——1963 年《城市与狗》出版，因直写军校腐败在秘鲁被当众焚毁，却一举奠定'拉美文学爆炸'主将地位——1966 年《绿房子》以多线并置结构写皮乌拉与亚马逊丛林，获罗慕洛·加列戈斯奖——1969 年《胡莉娅姨妈与作家》以双线交替结构把通俗剧与广播剧写作本身写进小说——1981 年《世界末日之战》出版，七年心血写巴西卡努杜斯起义，从此转入历史题材——1976-1979 年任国际笔会主席，为受迫害作家奔走——1980 年代由左翼转向古典自由主义——1987 年因反对秘鲁银行国有化从政，1990 年竞选总统败于藤森，此后定居马德里并归化西班牙（1993 年获西班牙籍，保留秘鲁籍）——2000 年《公羊的节日》以缜密史料写特鲁希略独裁的最后一天，确立'历史小说的工艺范本'——2003 年当选西班牙皇家学院院士——2010 年获诺贝尔文学奖，授奖词称其'对权力结构进行了细致的描绘，对个人的抵抗、反抗与失败给予了犀利的叙述'——2025 年 4 月 13 日在利马逝世，享年 89 岁，秘鲁为其举行国葬
era_en: Born 1936 in Arequipa, Peru, to a middle-class family; childhood in Cochabamba (Bolivia) and Piura—boarding at Lima's Leoncio Prado military academy as a teenager became the seed of The Time of the Hero—law and letters at San Marcos in the 1950s while working as a journalist; his marriage to 'Aunt Julia' later fed Aunt Julia and the Scriptwriter—first to Paris in 1958, then long years in Europe (Paris, London, Barcelona), looking back at Peru from 'the Latin American abroad'—The Time of the Hero (1963) was publicly burned in Lima for its picture of academy corruption yet instantly made him a chief of the Latin American Boom—The Green House (1966) braided Piura and the Amazon in a multi-strand structure and won the Romulo Gallegos Prize—Aunt Julia and the Scriptwriter (1969) alternated two registers, melodrama and radio soap itself, in a double-track design—The War of the End of the World (1981), seven years of labor on Brazil's Canudos rebellion, turned him decisively to historical material—president of International PEN 1976-1979, campaigning for persecuted writers—moved from the left to classical liberalism in the 1980s—entered politics in 1987 against the nationalization of Peruvian banks, lost the 1990 presidential runoff to Fujimori, settled in Madrid and took Spanish citizenship (1993, keeping the Peruvian)—The Feast of the Goat (2000) reconstructed the last day of the Trujillo dictatorship from dense documentation, setting the craft standard for the modern historical novel—elected to the Spanish Royal Academy in 2003—Nobel Prize in Literature 2010, cited for 'his cartography of structures of power and his trenchant images of the individual's resistance, revolt, and defeat'—died in Lima on 13 April 2025 at 89, given a state funeral
school: '总体小说'的工程师（把小说当作容纳全部世界的总体建筑）/ 历史小说的工艺立法者（史料先于虚构，证据与想象焊接）/ 权力结构的解剖者（写专制、写军营、写教堂、写政党的生理学）/ 叙事技术的实验者（对位、熔接、泄密式传动）/ 古典自由主义的写作者（从左翼到自由主义的思想迁移写进小说与政论）
historical_significance: 马里奥·巴尔加斯·略萨（1936-2025），秘鲁小说家、散文家、政论家，2010 年诺贝尔文学奖得主，'拉丁美洲文学爆炸'四主将之一。他的历史地位由五件事锚定。其一，《城市与狗》：把秘鲁军校写成微型专制国家，'谎言、告密与暴力如何制度化为日常'——小说在国内被焚毁，反而成为对军政文化的最著名控诉。其二，叙事技术的革新：他从福克纳与多斯·帕索斯学来多线结构，又自创'熔接时间'（把不同时刻的对话并置熔为一炉）与'对位法'（《绿房子》《胡莉娅姨妈与作家》的多声部并置），深刻影响了此后拉美小说的工艺标准。其三，'总体小说'的抱负：受福楼拜'小说包罗一切'的信念驱动，他论证小说家必须先成为其世界的学者——《世界末日之战》写卡努杜斯起义，先做数年史料研究再动笔，把'欧洲的末世论在巴西内陆燃成大火'写成拉美最厚重的历史小说之一。其四，权力解剖：从军营（《城市与狗》）到妓院与亚马逊（《绿房子》）到独裁者的卧室（《公羊的节日》），他反复解剖同一命题——权力如何腐蚀一切制度与亲密关系，个人如何在其中抵抗、共谋或毁灭。其五，'作家从政'的现代样本：1987 年组建自由运动、1990 年竞选总统、败选后转向古典自由主义与政论写作（《水中鱼》）——他是'文学爆炸'一代唯一把小说议题直接兑现为政治行动的人。代价与极限：他对左翼的清算有时滑向全盘否定（与聂鲁达的公开对立、与富恩特斯的决裂）；情欲题材三部曲（《继母颂》等）艺术上褒贬不一；1990 年败选与归化西班牙使部分同胞视其为'离乡的贵族'。2025 年 4 月的逝世与国葬，标志'爆炸一代'作为活体记忆的落幕。
historical_significance_en: Mario Vargas Llosa (1936-2025), Peruvian novelist, essayist and polemicist, winner of the 2010 Nobel Prize, was one of the four chiefs of the Latin American Boom. Five achievements anchor his standing. First, The Time of the Hero: writing a Peruvian military academy as a miniature tyranny—how lying, informing and violence become institutionalized as daily routine—the book was burned in Lima and so became the most famous indictment of the military-political culture of the era. Second, narrative innovation: from Faulkner and Dos Passos he learned multi-strand structure, then invented his own 'fusion of time' (dialogues of different moments melted into one) and musical counterpoint (The Green House, Aunt Julia and the Scriptwriter), setting a craft standard for Latin American fiction after him. Third, the ambition of the 'total novel': driven by Flaubert's conviction that the novel contains everything, he argued the novelist must first become a scholar of his world—The War of the End of the World on the Canudos rebellion was written only after years of documentary research: a European apocalyptic fire burning in the Brazilian backlands, among the heaviest historical novels of Latin America. Fourth, the anatomy of power: from the barracks (The Time of the Hero) through the brothel and the jungle (The Green House) to the dictator's bedroom (The Feast of the Goat), he dissected one proposition—how power corrodes every institution and intimacy, and how the individual resists, conspires or perishes within it. Fifth, the modern sample of the writer in politics: founding the Libertad movement in 1987, running for president in 1990, and after defeat turning to classical liberalism and polemics (A Fish in the Water)—he is the only Boom novelist who cashed literary themes directly into political action. Costs and limits: his settling of accounts with the left sometimes slid into blanket repudiation (public opposition to Neruda, rupture with Fuentes); the erotic trilogy (In Praise of the Stepmother and after) met mixed reviews; the 1990 defeat and the naturalization in Spain led some compatriots to see him as an expatriate aristocrat. His death in April 2025 and state funeral marked the closing of the Boom generation as living memory.
unique_thinking: 他思维方式的底色是'先造世界、再造叙事：小说是证据与谎言的焊接，权力是必须被解剖的机体'。六个标志性动作。其一，'总体小说法'——写之前先把对象世界研究成一门学问：福楼拜式的信念，小说要包罗一切，作家要成为笔下巴拿马运河式的'百科全书'。其二，'证据嫁接法'——史料与虚构的焊接工艺：《公羊的节日》先穷尽特鲁希略档案与口述，再让虚构人物钻进史料的缝隙；'考据不许出错，缝隙由想象填补'。其三，'对抗引擎法'——他师法福楼拜的论断'小说需要敌手'：每一个故事必须先找到它的对抗性冲突（军营与少年、独裁者与刺客、城市与丛林），情节是这台引擎的传动。其四，'双线对位法'——像作曲家写对位：两条以上叙事线各自独立又互相照明，交替推进至交叉（《绿房子》《胡莉娅姨妈与作家》），让结构本身产生意义。其五，'熔时接空法'——把不同时刻的对话与场景熔接并置，取消'过去/现在'的舞台提示，让读者在时间错位中自己重建因果——这是他对线性叙事最持久的破坏。其六，'权力解剖法'——把每一种权力（军阶、神权、党权、父权、情欲权力）当作生理系统来写：器官、循环、病变与癌变，解剖刀下没有浪漫化。代价与极限：'总体小说'的学术化准备有时压垮叙事速度（《世界末日之战》的中段）；对抗引擎的强度依赖使日常题材失色；自由主义的信念使他对革命想象的批判近乎免疫于其真实成就；晚年政论的政治立场使其文学判断染上阵营色彩。
unique_thinking_en: The bedrock of his thinking: build the world before the narrative—the novel is a weld of evidence and lies, and power is an organism that must be dissected. Six signature moves. First, the total novel—before writing, research the world of the subject into a discipline: the Flaubertian conviction that the novel must contain everything and the novelist become an encyclopedia of his territory. Second, document-grafting—the craft of welding archive to fiction: The Feast of the Goat exhausts the Trujillo record and testimony before fictional characters are slipped into the seams; 'the research must be beyond error; imagination fills only the gaps.' Third, the antagonist engine—his Flaubertian maxim 'a novel needs an adversary': every story must first locate its antagonistic conflict (cadets against the academy, dictator against assassins, city against jungle), and plot is the transmission of that engine. Fourth, counterpoint of tracks—like a composer writing counterpoint: two or more narrative lines, each independent yet lighting the other, alternating until they cross (The Green House, Aunt Julia and the Scriptwriter), meaning arising from the structure itself. Fifth, the fusion of time—dialogues and scenes of different moments melted together, stage directions of past and present abolished, the reader rebuilding causality inside the temporal displacement—his most durable assault on linear narrative. Sixth, the anatomy of power—every form of power (rank, clergy, party, patriarchy, erotic power) written as a physiological system: organs, circulation, lesions and cancer; under the scalpel nothing is romanticized. Costs and limits: the scholarly preparation of the total novel sometimes crushed narrative pace (the middle of The War of the End of the World); the engine's dependence on antagonism dimmed quieter subjects; his liberal faith made his critique of revolutionary imagination nearly immune to its real achievements; late political polemic tinted his literary judgments with camp color.

civilization_en: The Andean creole civilization of Peru (twentieth and twenty-first centuries): the middle-class society of Arequipa and Lima, the marginal worlds of the Andean highlands and the Amazon, the expatriate network of Latin American intellectuals across Paris-Madrid-London—in dialogue with European modernist narrative craft (Flaubert, Faulkner, Dos Passos) and the classical liberal political tradition

modes.domain_zh: 《给青年小说家的信》（1997）是这套方法论的公开课：略萨在第九封信里把'作家的忍耐'定义为'研究先行'——《世界末日之战》（1981）写巴西卡努杜斯起义，他先花数年读欧克里德斯·达·库尼亚《腹地》及全部可得的档案、地方志与口述，把帝制末年的巴西内陆研究成一门学问才动笔；《公羊的节日》（2000）同样先穷尽特鲁希略时代的文献与证人。他自述福楼拜为'作家的圣徒'：福楼拜为写一部小说研究整座城市的档案。方法的纲领是：虚构的可信性不是天赋，是准备量的函数——读者感到'这世界真实存在'，是因为作者在看不见的地方做完了全部功课。代价清晰可见：准备有时压垮速度（《世界末日之战》中段的沉重），且研究若不为叙事服务就沦为炫学。
modes.domain_en: Letters to a Young Novelist (1997) is the public course of this methodology: in the ninth letter Vargas Llosa defines 'the writer's patience' as research-first—The War of the End of the World (1981), on Brazil's Canudos rebellion, came only after years reading Euclides da Cunha's Os Sertoes and every obtainable archive, chronicle and testimony, the Brazilian backlands at the empire's end researched into a discipline before the first sentence; The Feast of the Goat (2000) likewise exhausted the documents and witnesses of the Trujillo era. He named Flaubert 'the saint of writers': Flaubert studied the archives of a whole city to write one novel. The program: the credibility of fiction is not a gift but a function of preparation—readers feel the world exists because the author finished all the homework where they cannot see. The cost is visible: preparation sometimes crushed pace (the heaviness at the middle of The War of the End of the World), and research that does not serve narrative turns into pedantry.

modes.key_quote_zh: 小说家不写作的时候，就该像个学者那样生活。
modes.key_quote_en: When the novelist is not writing, he should live like a scholar.
process_zh: 动笔前为对象世界开列'研究清单'：地理、经济、阶层、语言、权力结构五个维度，逐项标注已知与未知
为每个未知项指定证据来源（档案、地方志、亲历者口述、实地走访），并规定'证据不齐不动笔'的门槛
把研究成果整理成'世界卷宗'：年表、人物关系图、词汇表、制度说明——供写作时随时查证
写完后反向检验：任何一处描述若在卷宗中找不到依据，或删或改为有据之写——研究是地基，不是装饰
process_en: Before writing, draw a research checklist for the subject world across five dimensions—geography, economy, class, language, power structures—marking what is known and unknown
Assign each unknown an evidence source (archives, chronicles, testimony, field visits) and set the threshold: no writing until the evidence clears
Organize findings into a world dossier: chronology, relationship map, glossary, institutional notes—for checking at any moment while writing
After drafting, verify in reverse: any description without a basis in the dossier is cut or rewritten on evidence—research is the foundation, not ornament
representative_cases_zh: 《世界末日之战》：数年研读《腹地》与卡努杜斯档案后才动笔，把 1897 年巴伊亚内陆的宗教起义写成拉美最厚重的总体小说——研究先行法的完整示范
《公羊的节日》：穷尽特鲁希略三十年独裁的文献、口述与庭审记录，再让虚构人物乌拉尼娅钻进史料的缝隙——考据托起虚构
《绿房子》：为写亚马逊丛林，他专程赴秘鲁东部林区实地生活与访谈，把'地理即情节'的准备做在动笔之前
representative_cases_en: The War of the End of the World: years reading Os Sertoes and the Canudos archives before writing—the complete demonstration of research-first, Brazil's 1897 religious rebellion as one of Latin America's heaviest total novels
The Feast of the Goat: the documents, testimonies and trial records of thirty years of Trujillo exhausted before the fictional Urena is slipped into the seams—documents holding fiction aloft
The Green House: to write the Amazon he traveled to the eastern Peruvian forest to live and interview—the preparation of 'geography as plot' done before the first draft
modern_applications_zh: 行业小说/剧本：写一个行业前先完成'研究清单'五维度调查，把术语、制度与潜规则整理成卷宗再写人物
深度报道：选题后先建'证据卷宗'（档案+访谈+实地），未达门槛不落笔——可信性是准备量的函数
创业尽调：进入一个市场前把地理、经济、阶层、语言（用户黑话）、权力结构五项研究成学问，再定战略
modern_applications_en: Industry fiction or screenwriting: before writing about a trade, run the five-dimension research checklist and compile terms, institutions and unwritten rules into a dossier before creating characters
Investigative reporting: after picking the topic, build an evidence dossier (archives plus interviews plus fieldwork); do not write until the threshold clears—credibility is a function of preparation
Startup due diligence: before entering a market, research geography, economy, class, language (user jargon) and power structures into a discipline, then set strategy

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who legislated research-first as the first credo of narrative craft

representative_figures.relation_en: the provider of material—Os Sertoes wrote Canudos with an engineer's fieldwork, the documentary foundation of The War of the End of the World

name_zh: 历史小说工艺/史料与虚构的焊接——先穷尽档案与口述使考据无懈可击，再让虚构人物钻进史料的缝隙；'考据不许出错，缝隙由想象填补'，证据与谎言在接缝处彼此加固
name_en: historical-novel craft/the weld of archive and fiction—exhaust the documents and testimony until the scholarship is beyond attack, then slip fictional characters into the seams of the record; 'the research must be beyond error; imagination fills only the gaps'—evidence and lies reinforcing each other at the joint
category: 历史小说工艺/史料与虚构的焊接——先穷尽档案与口述使考据无懈可击，再让虚构人物钻进史料的缝隙；'考据不许出错，缝隙由想象填补'，证据与谎言在接缝处彼此加固
modes.domain_zh: 《公羊的节日》（2000）是这套焊接工艺的范本：特鲁希略被刺的 1961 年 5 月 30 日，刺客是谁、几点出发、如何被截、独裁者死在座驾哪个座位——全部按庭审档案与亲历者证词重建；而叙述者乌拉尼娅——独裁者智囊流亡三十四年后回国的女儿——是完全虚构的，她的家庭创伤被嫁接进真实的时间线，成为读者进入史料的私人通道。略萨自述原则：'历史部分不许有错，因为一个可证的错误会摧毁整本书的信用；虚构部分不许畏缩，因为缝隙正是想象的领地。'这与《世界末日之战》一脉相承：卡努杜斯的历史骨干（'劝世者'、帝国军四次远征、最终屠城）全部有据，虚构人物（近视记者、加利的部下）在缝隙中移动。嫁接的要害是方向：证据是地基，想象只许在地基之上建筑——绝不为情节方便篡改可考事实。
modes.domain_en: The Feast of the Goat (2000) is the model of this welding: for 30 May 1961, the day Trujillo was shot—who the assassins were, when they set out, how the ambush was laid, which seat the dictator died in—is rebuilt from trial records and witness testimony, while the narrator Urana, daughter of the dictator's counselor returning from thirty-four years of exile, is wholly fictional: her family trauma is grafted onto the true timeline as the private corridor by which readers enter the record. Vargas Llosa stated the principle: 'the historical part admits no error, for one provable mistake destroys the credit of the whole book; the fictional part admits no timidity, for the seams are the territory of imagination.' The War of the End of the World continues the line: the historical skeleton of Canudos—the Counselor, the empire's four expeditions, the final massacre—is all documented, while invented figures (the nearsighted journalist, Galileo Gall) move in the seams. The crux is direction: evidence is the foundation and imagination may build only upon it—never bending a checkable fact for the plot's convenience.
modes.definition_zh: 历史小说工艺/史料与虚构的焊接——先穷尽档案与口述使考据无懈可击，再让虚构人物钻进史料的缝隙；'考据不许出错，缝隙由想象填补'，证据与谎言在接缝处彼此加固
modes.definition_en: Historical-novel craft/the weld of archive and fiction—exhaust the documents and testimony until the scholarship is beyond attack, then slip fictional characters into the seams of the record; 'the research must be beyond error; imagination fills only the gaps'
modes.source_chapter: 《公羊的节日》（2000）及创作谈；《世界末日之战》（1981）序与访谈；《给青年小说家的信》论历史小说；回忆录《水中鱼》
key_concepts: 考据零错零容忍 zero tolerance for scholarly error
缝隙里的虚构虚构 in the seams of the record
私人通道 the private corridor
接缝加固 mutual reinforcement at the joint
不为情节篡改事实 no bending facts for plot
modes.key_quote_zh: 历史部分一个可证的错误，就能摧毁整本书的信用。
modes.key_quote_en: One provable error in the historical part can destroy the credit of the whole book.
process_zh: 把题材切分为'可考层'与'缝隙层'：人物、日期、地点、结果归可考层，动机、对话、私域归缝隙层
可考层执行零容忍核证：每一条可查证陈述都要有两处独立证据，查不到的降级为传闻并明示
设计虚构人物时先画'缝隙图'：标出史料沉默或矛盾的位置，让虚构只活动在这些位置
成稿后双轨校验：可考层逐条对档案，缝隙层逐条确认未侵占可考事实——接缝处两边都要硬
process_en: Split the subject into a documentable layer and a seam layer: persons, dates, places, outcomes to the former; motives, dialogue, the private sphere to the latter
Run zero-tolerance verification on the documentable layer: every checkable claim needs two independent sources; what cannot be verified is downgraded to rumor and marked as such
When designing fictional characters, first draw a seam map marking where the record is silent or contradictory—fiction may act only there
After drafting, verify both tracks: the documentable layer against the archive line by line, the seam layer to confirm no checkable fact was invaded—both sides of the joint must hold
representative_cases_zh: 《公羊的节日》：特鲁希略遇刺全程按庭审与证词重建，虚构的乌拉尼娅家族创伤嫁接进真实时间线——证据嫁接法的完整示范
《世界末日之战》：卡努杜斯起义的骨干史实（劝世者、四次远征、屠城）有据可查，近视记者等虚构人物只在史料的缝隙中移动
《狂人玛伊塔》：为写 1958 年一个失败的城市游击小组，他重访全部幸存者，把口述史与虚构叙述交替编排，让读者在证词与小说之间穿行
representative_cases_en: The Feast of the Goat: the assassination rebuilt from trial records and testimony, the fictional Urena family trauma grafted onto the true timeline—the complete demonstration
The War of the End of the World: the documented skeleton of Canudos (the Counselor, four expeditions, the massacre) with invented figures moving only in the seams of the record

The Real Life of Alejandro Mayta: for a failed 1958 urban guerrilla cell he re-interviewed every survivor, alternating oral history with fictional narration so readers walk between testimony and novel
modern_applications_zh: 纪实文学/非虚构写作：把题材切成'可考层'与'缝隙层'，可考层零容忍核证，重建场景只写在缝隙里
企业史/品牌故事：公司大事年表逐条对档案（可考层），创始人心路用'缝隙图'标注哪些是推断——接缝两边都要硬
司法/调查报告：重建事件时间线时区分'证据链内'与'推断'，任何推断不侵占证据链，并在文中明示
modern_applications_en: Literary nonfiction: split the subject into documentable and seam layers; zero-tolerance verification on the former, reconstruction only in the latter
Corporate history or brand story: the timeline checked line by line against archives (documentable layer), the founder's inner path marked on a seam map as inference—both sides of the joint hard
Judicial or investigative reports: when rebuilding a timeline, separate 'inside the evidence chain' from 'inference'; no inference may invade the chain, and it must be marked in the text

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who legislated 'zero scholarly error, imagination in the seams' as historical-novel craft

representative_figures.relation_zh: 同时代平行——'非虚构小说'以真实案件为骨架，与略萨的嫁接工艺互为镜面
representative_figures.relation_en: the contemporary parallel—'nonfiction fiction' on the skeleton of a true case mirrors the grafting craft from the Anglophone side

representative_figures.relation_en: the ancient distant source—the spirit of corroboration by itineraries and testimony shares the credo 'the record admits no error,' while literary imagination fills the seams

name_zh: 情节设计方法论/'小说需要敌手'——每个故事动笔前必须先找到它的对抗性冲突（军营与少年、独裁者与刺客、城市与丛林），情节只是这台引擎的传动装置；找不到敌手，就不动笔
name_en: plot-design methodology/'a novel needs an adversary'—before writing, every story must first locate its antagonistic conflict (cadets against the academy, dictator against assassins, city against jungle); plot is only the transmission of that engine; without an adversary, no writing
category: 情节设计方法论/'小说需要敌手'——每个故事动笔前必须先找到它的对抗性冲突（军营与少年、独裁者与刺客、城市与丛林），情节只是这台引擎的传动装置；找不到敌手，就不动笔
modes.domain_zh: 略萨在《给青年小说家的信》里反复申明：小说的核心不是人物或主题，而是'激起读者焦虑的对抗力量'。《城市与狗》（1963）的引擎是少年与军校这座微型专制国家的对抗——'美洲豹'与阿尔贝托、士兵与军阶制度，谎言与告密是发动机的活塞；《绿房子》（1966）的引擎是丛林与城市的对抗——印第安人、传教士、军警与商人在亚马逊与皮乌拉之间被同一台绞肉机吸入；《公羊的节日》的引擎是独裁者与刺客集团的对抗——权力机器的每一根齿轮（走狗、告密者、共谋的妻子）都为这一对抗供油。他自述受福楼拜'小说需要敌手'句式的启发：先找到对抗，再让情节去传动——情节设计不是'接着发生什么'，而是'对抗如何升级、变形与付出代价'。代价与极限：引擎的强度依赖使安静、日常、无对抗的题材在他笔下失色；晚年把'自由与暴政'当作万能引擎，有时使小说冲突模板化。
modes.domain_en: In Letters to a Young Novelist Vargas Llosa repeats: the core of a novel is neither character nor theme but 'the antagonistic force that arouses the reader's anxiety.' In The Time of the Hero (1963) the engine is the cadets against the academy as a miniature tyranny—the Jaguar and Alberto, soldiers against the rank system, with lying and informing as the engine's pistons; in The Green House (1966) it is jungle against city—Indians, missionaries, police and merchants drawn between the Amazon and Piura into the same mill; in The Feast of the Goat it is the dictator against the assassins—every gear of the power machine (henchmen, informers, the conspiring wife) feeding that opposition. He credited Flaubert's formula 'a novel needs an adversary': locate the conflict first, then let plot transmit it—plot design is not 'what happens next' but 'how the conflict escalates, mutates, and exacts its price.' Costs and limits: the engine's dependence on intensity dimmed quiet, everyday, conflict-less subjects; late in life 'liberty against tyranny' became a universal engine, sometimes templating his fictional conflicts.
modes.definition_zh: 情节设计方法论/'小说需要敌手'——每个故事动笔前必须先找到它的对抗性冲突，情节只是这台引擎的传动装置；找不到敌手，就不动笔
modes.definition_en: Plot-design methodology/'a novel needs an adversary'—before writing, every story must first locate its antagonistic conflict; plot is only the transmission of that engine; without an adversary, no writing
modes.source_chapter: 《给青年小说家的信》（1997，论'对抗力量'与情节）；《城市与狗》（1963）；《绿房子》（1966）；《公羊的节日》（2000）
key_concepts: 小说需要敌手 a novel needs an adversary
对抗先于情节 conflict before plot
传动装置 plot as transmission
对抗的升级与变价 escalation and price of conflict
引擎强度依赖 dependence on engine intensity
modes.key_quote_zh: 先找到敌手，情节自会跟上。
modes.key_quote_en: Find the adversary first; the plot will follow.
process_zh: 动笔前用一句话写出'谁对抗谁、为何不能罢休'——写不出这句话就不动笔
把对抗分解为三层：可见冲突（事件层）、制度对抗（规则层）、价值对抗（信念层），三层必须同轴
为每一章问'对抗在此升级了吗'：没有升级的章节不是删除就是重写为升级的铺垫
收束时检验'对抗的代价'：冲突必须让各方付出不可逆的代价，否则引擎熄火、读者不信
process_en: Before writing, state in one sentence 'who opposes whom, and why neither can stop'—if the sentence cannot be written, do not start
Decompose the conflict into three layers: visible clash (events), institutional opposition (rules), value conflict (belief)—all three must share one axis
For every chapter ask 'did the conflict escalate here': chapters without escalation are cut or rewritten as setup for escalation
At closure test 'the price of the conflict': the conflict must exact irreversible costs from all sides, or the engine stalls and readers stop believing
representative_cases_zh: 《城市与狗》：少年与军校微型专制的三层对抗（斗殴事件层/军阶制度层/告密与荣誉的信念层）同轴运转——对抗引擎法的开山示范
《公羊的节日》：独裁者与刺客集团的对抗驱动全书三线（刺杀当日、独裁者垂死六小时、乌拉尼娅的回忆），权力的每一根齿轮为对抗供油
《世界末日之战》：劝世者的末世信仰与帝国的世俗秩序对抗，四次远征即对抗的四次升级，代价以屠城收束
representative_cases_en: The Time of the Hero: the three-layer conflict of cadets against the miniature tyranny (fistfights, the rank system, the beliefs of informing and honor) running on one axis—the founding demonstration
The Feast of the Goat: dictator against assassins driving three tracks (the day of the killing, the dictator's six dying hours, Urena's memory), every gear of power feeding the opposition
The War of the End of the World: the Counselor's apocalyptic faith against imperial secular order; the four expeditions are four escalations, the price closed by massacre
modern_applications_zh: 商业案例写作：先写'谁对抗谁、为何不能罢休'一句话，再展开案例——没有对抗的商业叙事是流水账
谈判与诉讼策略：把争端分解为事件层、规则层、信念层，确认三层同轴后再选攻防点
产品立项：立项书先回答'我们的产品对抗什么、用户为何不能罢休'，无对抗答案的项目缓批
modern_applications_en: Business case writing: open with one sentence—'who opposes whom and why neither can stop'—before unfolding; commercial narrative without conflict is a ledger
Negotiation and litigation strategy: decompose the dispute into events, rules and beliefs, confirm the three share one axis, then choose points of attack
Product proposals: the proposal must answer 'what does the product oppose, and why can users not stop'—proposals without a conflict answer are deferred

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who wrote 'a novel needs an adversary' as the first law of plot craft

representative_figures.relation_zh: 句式的提供者——'小说需要敌手'的先师，以爱玛与庸俗社会的对抗驱动《包法利夫人》
representative_figures.relation_en: provider of the formula—the precursor of 'a novel needs an adversary,' driving Madame Bovary on Emma's conflict with philistine society

representative_figures.relation_en: the ancient distant source—every tragedy engine-driven by a conflict that cannot stop, historical proof of conflict before plot

name_zh: 结构设计方法论/像作曲家写对位：两条以上叙事线各自独立又互相照明，交替推进直至交叉（《绿房子》《胡莉娅姨妈与作家》），让结构本身产生意义——读者在声部之间听出单线叙述听不见的和声
name_en: structural methodology/counterpoint as a composer writes it: two or more narrative lines, each independent yet lighting the other, alternating until they cross (The Green House, Aunt Julia and the Scriptwriter)—meaning arising from the structure itself, readers hearing between the voices harmonies a single line cannot sound
category: 结构设计方法论/像作曲家写对位：两条以上叙事线各自独立又互相照明，交替推进直至交叉，让结构本身产生意义——读者在声部之间听出单线叙述听不见的和声
modes.domain_zh: 《绿房子》（1966）是这套对位法的成型之作：安塞尔莫建绿房子、鲍妮法西娅被逐出修道院、伏屋在亚马逊沉沦、利马马斯基塔上尉的升迁——四条线各自有完整的时间与空间，按'交替切块'编排，交替本身制造悬念与对照；最后一章四线并置合流，读者才看清它们是同一台绞肉机的四个进料口。他自述方法来自音乐：'我想要读者像听赋格一样读小说，声部各自进行，意义在和声里。'《胡莉娅姨妈与作家》（1969）走得更远：自传主线（'我'与胡莉娅姨妈的婚事）与广播剧作家卡马乔的连续剧交替，每章之间的'剧'都是主线关系的扭曲镜像——对位升级为戏仿与自反。方法的要害：各线必须独立成立（每条单独读是完整故事），交叉必须改变意义（并置后产生单线没有的判断）——两个条件缺一，多线只是散装。
modes.domain_en: The Green House (1966) is where the counterpoint took form: Anselmo building the green house, Bonifacia expelled from the mission, Furtivo sinking in the Amazon, Captain Lituma's rise in Lima—four lines each complete in time and space, arranged in alternating blocks whose alternation itself creates suspense and contrast; in the last chapter the four are set side by side and merge, and the reader sees they were four intakes of the same mill. He described the method in musical terms: 'I want the reader to read the novel as a fugue—voices proceeding each on its own, meaning in the harmony.' Aunt Julia and the Scriptwriter (1969) goes further: the autobiographic main line (young Varguitas marrying Aunt Julia) alternates with the serials of scriptwriter Camacho, each intercalated serial a distorted mirror of the main line—counterpoint upgraded to parody and self-reflection. The crux: each line must stand alone (each a complete story by itself), and the crossing must change meaning (juxtaposition must yield a judgment no single line contains)—miss either condition and multi-strand is merely loose bundling.
modes.definition_zh: 结构设计方法论/像作曲家写对位：两条以上叙事线各自独立又互相照明，交替推进直至交叉，让结构本身产生意义
modes.definition_en: Structural methodology/counterpoint as a composer writes it: two or more narrative lines, each independent yet lighting the other, alternating until they cross—meaning arising from the structure itself
modes.source_chapter: 《绿房子》（1966，罗慕洛·加列戈斯奖演说谈结构）；《胡莉娅姨妈与作家》（1969）；《给青年小说家的信》论空间理论与多线结构
key_concepts: 声部独立 independence of voices
交替切块 alternating blocks
并置产生判断 juxtaposition as judgment
镜像声部 mirror voices
散装对位之戒 against loose multi-strand
modes.key_quote_zh: 我想要读者像听赋格一样读小说。
modes.key_quote_en: I want the reader to read the novel as a fugue.
process_zh: 先为每条线写独立的'单线梗概'：每条线单独成篇且完整——不能独立成立的多线立即砍掉
设计'照明关系'：明确每两条线并置时互相揭示什么（因果、对照、镜像、反讽），无照明关系的并置不采用
编排交替节奏：以最短的线为节拍器决定切换频率，长线内部预留'合流钩'（时间、地点或人物的重逢点）
终稿检验交叉效应：把各线单独抽出重读，确认并置后的整体判断大于各线之和——否则退回重排
process_en: First write an independent synopsis per line: each must be complete as a standalone story—strands that cannot stand alone are cut at once
Design the lighting relations: define what every juxtaposition of two lines reveals (cause, contrast, mirror, irony); juxtapositions that illuminate nothing are not used
Arrange the alternation rhythm: the shortest line is the metronome setting switch frequency; reserve 'convergence hooks' inside longer lines (reunions of time, place, or person)
On the final draft test the crossing effect: reread each line extracted alone and confirm the whole's judgment exceeds the sum of strands—otherwise return to rearrangement
representative_cases_zh: 《绿房子》：四线（绿房子/修道院/亚马逊/利马）交替切块，终章合流揭示同一绞肉机——双线对位法的建筑级示范
《胡莉娅姨妈与作家》：婚事主线与卡马乔广播剧交替，每段'剧'都是主线的扭曲镜像——对位升级为自反戏仿
《叙事人》：都市人类学家与丛林叙事人的双声部交替，两种文明各自成篇、并置互照，结构本身即'失语的对照'
representative_cases_en: The Green House: four strands alternating in blocks, merging in the final chapter to reveal one mill—the architectural demonstration of counterpoint
Aunt Julia and the Scriptwriter: the marriage line alternating with Camacho's serials, each serial a distorted mirror—counterpoint upgraded to reflexive parody
The Storyteller: urban anthropologist and jungle storyteller in alternating duet, each complete alone, juxtaposed into mutual illumination—the structure itself the contrast of silenced voices
modern_applications_zh: 纪录片/专题片结构：为每条人物线拍出独立成立的短章，剪辑时以'照明关系'决定交替点——观众在并置中自己得出判断
年度报告多线叙事：业务、组织、风险、文化四线分章自洽，终章并置合流揭示同一主题
教学设计：把跨学科内容设计为'可独立完成的单线任务+并置讨论'，让对照本身产生理解
modern_applications_en: Documentary structure: film each character strand as a standalone short chapter; let 'lighting relations' decide the edit points—viewers reach the judgment themselves in juxtaposition
Annual-report multi-line narrative: business, organization, risk, culture—each chapter self-contained, the final chapter merging them to reveal one theme
Curriculum design: cross-disciplinary content as standalone single-track tasks plus juxtaposed discussion, letting contrast itself produce understanding

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——把音乐对位立法为小说结构工艺
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who legislated musical counterpoint as structural craft for the novel

representative_figures.relation_zh: 方法的先师——《喧哗与骚动》的多视角声部直接启发了略萨的对位结构
representative_figures.relation_en: the precursor of the method—the multi-voice sections of The Sound and the Fury directly inspired his counterpoint

representative_figures.relation_zh: 技术的原型——赋格的声部独立与和声统一，是'独立又照明'的结构理想
representative_figures.relation_en: the archetype of the technique—the fugue's independent voices in harmonic unity, the structural ideal of 'independent yet lighting'

name_zh: 时序工艺/把不同时刻的对话与场景熔接并置，取消'过去/现在'的舞台提示——读者在时间错位中自己重建因果；这是他对线性叙事最持久的破坏
name_en: chronological craft/dialogues and scenes of different moments melted and set side by side, stage directions of past and present abolished—the reader rebuilding causality inside the temporal displacement; his most durable assault on linear narrative
category: 时序工艺/把不同时刻的对话与场景熔接并置，取消'过去/现在'的舞台提示——读者在时间错位中自己重建因果；这是他对线性叙事最持久的破坏
modes.domain_zh: 《城市与狗》（1963）把这套时序工艺推向极端：'美洲豹'的童年、军校的日常、偷题事件、扫射演习与凶案调查，被打碎后按情绪逻辑而非物理时序熔接；最著名的是对话熔接——不同年份的两场对话不加任何提示直接接续，读者从语气的断裂中自己认出'时间跳了'。略萨自述这是从福克纳《喧哗与骚动》学来又推进一步的：福克纳用不同叙述者分工时序，他干脆取消分工，让熔接本身成为叙事。在《公羊的节日》里熔接承担结构：刺杀当日、独裁者垂死的六小时、乌拉尼娅三十四年后的回忆三条时间线在章节内部熔为一体，'过去与现在互为因果的绞索'。方法的前提与代价：熔接要求读者的重建劳动，错位超过读者承受力就成了迷宫而非叙事——他后期作品（《叙事人》《公羊的节日》）的熔接更节制，正说明他清楚这条工艺的容错边界。
modes.domain_en: The Time of the Hero (1963) pushed this craft to the extreme: the Jaguar's childhood, academy routine, the stolen-exam affair, the firing exercise and the murder investigation, shattered and melted by emotional rather than physical chronology; most famous is the fused dialogue—two conversations of different years joined with no signal at all, readers recognizing from the break in tone that 'time has jumped.' Vargas Llosa described learning it from Faulkner's The Sound and the Fury and going one step further: Faulkner divided the chronology among narrators; he abolished the division and let fusion itself narrate. In The Feast of the Goat fusion carries the structure: the day of the assassination, the dictator's six dying hours, and Urena's memory thirty-four years later melted together inside chapters—'past and present as each other's noose of cause.' The premise and the price: fusion demands the reader's labor of reconstruction; displacement beyond endurance becomes labyrinth, not narrative—his later books (The Storyteller, The Feast of the Goat) fuse more sparingly, proof he knew this craft's tolerance.
modes.definition_zh: 时序工艺/把不同时刻的对话与场景熔接并置，取消'过去/现在'的舞台提示——读者在时间错位中自己重建因果
modes.definition_en: Chronological craft/dialogues and scenes of different moments melted and set side by side, stage directions of past and present abolished—the reader rebuilding causality inside the temporal displacement
modes.source_chapter: 《城市与狗》（1963）及创作访谈；《给青年小说家的信》论时间与空间；论福克纳的评论文章；《公羊的节日》（2000）结构分析访谈
key_concepts: 取消舞台提示 no stage directions
对话熔接 fused dialogue
情绪时序 emotional chronology
读者重建劳动 the reader's labor of reconstruction
熔接容错边界 the tolerance of fusion
modes.key_quote_zh: 时间不需要被标明，需要被听见。
modes.key_quote_en: Time does not need to be labeled; it needs to be heard.
process_zh: 先把全部场景按物理时序排成'原版时间轴'——熔接的前提是手里有完整时序
改为'情绪时序'重排：按张力与因果邻近度决定场景出场顺序，时间标记一律删除
在时序跳点用'语气断层'代替提示：让对话的措辞、称呼、物理细节自己暴露年代变化
测试两位首次读者能否在三段内重建因果——重建失败处补最小限度的锚（一件年代物、一个年龄称谓），不恢复全量提示
process_en: First lay every scene on a physical timeline—fusion presumes the full chronology in hand
Rearrange by 'emotional chronology': order of appearance set by tension and causal proximity, time markers deleted wholesale
Replace signals at time jumps with 'breaks in tone': diction, forms of address and physical detail themselves exposing the change of era

Test with two first-time readers whether causality can be rebuilt within three passages—where reconstruction fails, add the minimal anchor (a dated object, an age-marked form of address), never the full signal
representative_cases_zh: 《城市与狗》：童年、军校、偷题、演习与调查按情绪逻辑熔接，对话跨年直接接续——熔时接空法的极端示范
《公羊的节日》：刺杀日、垂死六小时、三十四年后的回忆在章节内部熔为一体，过去与现在互为绞索
《胡莉娅姨妈与作家》：主线按物理时序、副线广播剧按播出时序，两条时序交替互撞制造反讽——熔接与对位的复合使用
representative_cases_en: The Time of the Hero: childhood, academy, the stolen exam, the exercise and the investigation melted by emotional logic, dialogue across years joined raw—the extreme demonstration
The Feast of the Goat: assassination day, six dying hours, memory after thirty-four years melted inside chapters—past and present as mutual noose
Aunt Julia and the Scriptwriter: main line on physical time, serials on broadcast time, the two chronologies alternating and colliding into irony—fusion composed with counterpoint
modern_applications_zh: 用户访谈报告：把不同时间的原始发言按主题熔接并置，用措辞变化自己暴露态度演变，不加'初期/后期'标签
短视频/广告脚本：跨时空场景硬切，靠服装、口音、道具的年代细节替代字幕交代时间
项目复盘文档：把'当时决定'与'今日验证'两列熔接成单一叙事，让读者在对照中重建决策因果
modern_applications_en: User-research reports: raw quotes from different dates melted side by side by theme, diction change itself exposing the shift in attitude—no 'early/late' labels
Short-video or ad scripts: hard cuts across time, era detail in wardrobe, accent and props replacing subtitle captions
Project retrospectives: 'the decision then' and 'the verification now' fused into a single narrative, readers rebuilding decision causality in the contrast

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who pushed fused chronology to abolishing all signals yet held the tolerance boundary

representative_figures.relation_zh: 方法的直接来源——《喧哗与骚动》的时序破碎是熔时接空法的技术母本
representative_figures.relation_en: the direct source—the shattered chronology of The Sound and the Fury, the technical matrix of fused time

representative_figures.relation_zh: 思想的远源——'非自主记忆'的时间错位证明了人对时间的经验本非线性
representative_figures.relation_en: the distant source of the idea—'involuntary memory' proved human experience of time is nonlinear to begin with

name_zh: 政治书写方法论/把每一种权力（军阶、神权、党权、父权、情欲权力）当作生理系统来写：器官、循环、病变与癌变——解剖刀下没有浪漫化，也没有漫画化
name_en: political-writing methodology/write every form of power (rank, clergy, party, patriarchy, erotic power) as a physiological system: organs, circulation, lesions and cancer—under the scalpel neither romanticized nor caricatured
category: 政治书写方法论/把每一种权力（军阶、神权、党权、父权、情欲权力）当作生理系统来写：器官、循环、病变与癌变——解剖刀下没有浪漫化，也没有漫画化
modes.domain_zh: 略萨的全部政治小说共享同一把解剖刀。《城市与狗》：军校的权力是一套循环系统——军阶是骨骼，告密是血液，' Circle '（圈子）是心脏，虐待新兵的仪式是它的代谢；他拒绝把军人写成恶魔，只精确记录制度如何把普通人变成部件。《绿房子》：传教士、军警、商人的权力各有器官，又在亚马逊互相供血。《公羊的节日》是解剖学的巅峰：特鲁希略的权力被写成机体——'元首'的性器官与宣传机器互为器官（他亲自挑选'猎物'，国债般计数的强奸是他权力的代谢），元老们的恐惧是循环系统，家庭里的共谋是神经末梢；刺客们不是英雄，是机体的坏死组织里长出的另一组病变。方法要害：解剖要求'双向拒绝'——既不浪漫化反抗者（刺客自私、怯懦、算账），也不漫画化掌权者（独裁者衰老、虚荣、被自己机器挟持）；权力的恶在结构里，不在个人品质里。
modes.domain_en: All of Vargas Llosa's political novels share one scalpel. The Time of the Hero: the academy's power is a circulatory system—rank the skeleton, informing the blood, the Circle the heart, the rituals of abusing recruits its metabolism; he refuses to write soldiers as demons, only precisely recording how institutions turn ordinary people into parts. The Green House: missionaries, police and merchants each have organs of power, feeding one another across the Amazon. The Feast of the Goat is the anatomy's summit: Trujillo's power written as an organism—the Chief's sexuality and the propaganda machine as mutual organs (his personally selected 'prey,' rapes counted like national debt, the metabolism of his power), the elders' fear the circulation, the family's complicity the nerve endings; the assassins are not heroes but another set of lesions growing in the necrotic tissue. The crux: anatomy demands a double refusal—neither romanticizing resisters (selfish, cowardly, settling accounts) nor caricaturing holders (the dictator aged, vain, hostage to his own machine); the evil of power lies in the structure, not in personal quality.
modes.definition_zh: 政治书写方法论/把每一种权力当作生理系统来写：器官、循环、病变与癌变——解剖刀下没有浪漫化，也没有漫画化
modes.definition_en: Political-writing methodology/write every form of power as a physiological system: organs, circulation, lesions and cancer—under the scalpel neither romanticized nor caricatured
modes.source_chapter: 《公羊的节日》（2000）；《城市与狗》（1963）；《给青年小说家的信》论'权力的主题'；2010 诺贝尔演说论文学与专制
key_concepts: 权力生理学 the physiology of power
双向拒绝 the double refusal
恶在结构 evil in the structure
器官与代谢 organs and metabolism
病变的对称 symmetry of lesions
modes.key_quote_zh: 权力的恶不在恶人的品质里，在机体的循环里。
modes.key_quote_en: The evil of power lies not in the qualities of the wicked but in the circulation of the organism.
process_zh: 先给权力画'器官图'：列出该权力系统的骨骼（制度）、血液（资源与信息）、心脏（核心机制）、代谢（日常运作）
追踪循环：写清权力如何从末端（新兵、农民、情妇）抽取养分并输送回核心——只写流动，不写口号
双向拒绝检查：反抗者不浪漫化（写其私利与怯懦），掌权者不漫画化（写其衰老、虚荣与被机器挟持）
找'病变对称'：展示压迫结构如何在反抗者身上复制自身——解剖的结论是结构的病理，不是人的善恶
process_en: Draw the organ chart of the power first: skeleton (institutions), blood (resources and information), heart (core mechanism), metabolism (daily operation)
Trace circulation: how power extracts nourishment from the periphery (recruits, peasants, mistresses) and returns it to the core—write flows, not slogans
Run the double-refusal check: no romanticizing resisters (write their self-interest and cowardice), no caricaturing holders (write their aging, vanity, hostage-hood to the machine)
Find the 'symmetry of lesions': show how the oppressive structure replicates itself inside resisters—the conclusion is the pathology of structure, not the virtue of persons
representative_cases_zh: 《公羊的节日》：特鲁希略权力机体的完整解剖（性器官即宣传器官、恐惧即循环、家族即神经末梢），刺客与政权病变对称——权力解剖法的巅峰
《城市与狗》：军校权力循环系统（军阶骨骼/告密血液/圈子心脏），制度把普通人变成部件而非恶魔
《狂人玛伊塔》：解剖革命组织的权力生理——自我纯洁化如何循环成背叛，左翼机体与右翼机体共享病理
representative_cases_en: The Feast of the Goat: the complete anatomy of Trujillo's organism (sexuality as propaganda organ, fear as circulation, family as nerve endings), assassins and regime in symmetric lesion—the summit of power anatomy
The Time of the Hero: the academy's circulatory system (rank the skeleton, informing the blood, the Circle the heart), institutions turning ordinary people into parts, not demons
The Real Life of Alejandro Mayta: the physiology of a revolutionary organization—how self-purification cycles into betrayal; the left's organism shares the pathology of the right's
modern_applications_zh: 组织诊断报告：把公司权力画成器官图（制度骨骼/信息血液/核心机制心脏），追踪末端如何被抽取——诊断结构而非指责个人
调查报道：双向拒绝原则——既写受害者也写其共谋，既写加害者也写其被机器挟持；恶在结构里
制度设计：立法/流程设计时检查'病变对称'——新制度是否会在执行者身上复制它要消灭的旧弊
modern_applications_en: Organizational diagnostics: draw the company's power as an organ chart (institutional skeleton, informational blood, core-mechanism heart), trace extraction from the periphery—diagnose structure, not persons
Investigative reporting: the double refusal—write victims and their complicity, perpetrators and their hostage-hood to the machine; evil in the structure
Institutional design: when writing laws or processes, check for 'symmetry of lesions'—does the new institution replicate in its enforcers the abuse it exists to abolish?

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——把权力写成机体并把解剖刀双拒原则立法的人
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who wrote power as organism and legislated the double refusal of the scalpel

representative_figures.relation_zh: 同题先师——《1984》解剖极权机体，与略萨共享'恶在结构'的信条而文体更寓言化
representative_figures.relation_en: the precursor on the same theme—1984 dissecting the totalitarian organism, sharing the credo 'evil in the structure' in a more allegorical style

representative_figures.relation_zh: 古代远源——第一位把权力当机体（而非道德剧场）冷静描述的人，解剖传统的鼻祖
representative_figures.relation_en: the ancient distant source—the first to describe power coolly as organism rather than moral theater, the ancestor of the anatomical tradition

name_zh: 阅读与批评方法论/要求叙事结构对读者透明可感：技巧不为炫技，读者必须能感到'有人在安排这一切'并因此更投入——结构是演出的一部分，不是后台机关
name_en: reading-and-criticism methodology/demand that narrative structure be perceptible to the reader: technique is not display—readers must feel 'someone is arranging all this' and be drawn in the more for it; structure is part of the performance, not backstage machinery
category: 阅读与批评方法论/要求叙事结构对读者透明可感：技巧不为炫技，读者必须能感到'有人在安排这一切'并因此更投入——结构是演出的一部分，不是后台机关
modes.domain_zh: 略萨作为批评家（《给青年小说家的信》《逆风顶浪》）一贯主张：小说的技术必须让读者'感到'而不必'看懂'——《绿房子》的四线并置读者未必能画出结构图，但能感到'有人在同时举起四只钟'；这种'可感到的安排'正是愉悦的来源。他在批评中惩罚两类失败：其一是'机关外露'（结构炫技使读者出戏），其二是'机关全隐'（结构若有若无使读者麻木）。这在他自己的修订实践中可见：他自述每部小说改五到十稿，多数修改不是改句子而是改结构——'让楼梯踩上去不出声，但存在感不减'。方法的可迁移性：任何面向受众的复杂构造（课程、产品、组织流程）都适用同一标准——复杂度可感、安排可知觉、机关不外露。
modes.domain_en: As a critic (Letters to a Young Novelist, Against Wind and Tide) Vargas Llosa consistently held: technique must be felt by the reader without being decoded—readers of The Green House may never draw the diagram of four strands, but they feel 'someone is holding up four clocks at once'; this perceptible arrangement is the very source of pleasure. In his criticism he punishes two failures: exposed machinery (structural showing-off that throws the reader out) and fully hidden machinery (structure so faint the reader goes numb). His revision practice shows it: he rewrote each novel five to ten times, most revisions structural rather than verbal—'make the staircase silent underfoot without dimming its presence.' Transferable: any complex construction facing an audience—courses, products, organizational processes—answers to the same standard: complexity felt, arrangement perceptible, machinery not exposed.
modes.definition_zh: 阅读与批评方法论/要求叙事结构对读者透明可感：技巧不为炫技，读者必须能感到'有人在安排这一切'并因此更投入——结构是演出的一部分，不是后台机关
modes.definition_en: Reading-and-criticism methodology/demand that narrative structure be perceptible to the reader: technique is not display—readers must feel 'someone is arranging all this' and be drawn in the more for it
modes.source_chapter: 《给青年小说家的信》（1997）；评论集《逆风顶浪》（Contra viento y marea）；创作访谈论修订与结构
key_concepts: 可感到的安排 perceptible arrangement
机关不外露 no exposed machinery
机关不全隐 no fully hidden machinery
结构即演出 structure as performance
五至十稿的修订律 the five-to-ten-draft discipline
modes.key_quote_zh: 让楼梯踩上去不出声，但存在感不减。
modes.key_quote_en: Make the staircase silent underfoot without dimming its presence.
process_zh: 为复杂构造写'结构意图'一句话：希望受众'感到什么被安排了'——写不出即退回简化
自检两类失败：机关外露（受众在猜技巧而非接收内容）与机关全隐（受众感觉不到任何安排）——两者都改
用'盲测'代替自评：请未参与设计者使用后复述'这个东西是怎么组织的'，复述出的层次即为透明度
修订时优先改结构而非表层：五到十稿的纪律——每稿只回答一个问题'哪里让人出戏或无感'
process_en: Write the 'structural intention' in one sentence: what the audience should feel was arranged—if it cannot be written, return to simplification
Self-check the two failures: exposed machinery (the audience guessing technique instead of receiving content) and hidden machinery (the audience feeling no arrangement at all)—fix both
Blind-test instead of self-review: ask an uninvolved user afterward how 'this thing is organized'; the levels they name are the transparency
In revision, change structure before surface: the five-to-ten-draft discipline—each draft answers one question, 'where does one stumble or feel nothing'
representative_cases_zh: 《绿房子》的修订：初稿按线性时序写成，他推倒重排为四线并置——'读者应感到四只钟同时被举起'——结构透明法在作者侧的实践
《给青年小说家的信》：以批评家身份系统惩罚'机关外露'与'机关全隐'两类失败，为透明度立法
《公羊的节日》三条时间线的章节内熔接：读者未必能画出时间结构图，但能感到'三只钟在互相对表'——可感而不可解码
representative_cases_en: The revision of The Green House: a first linear draft demolished and rearranged into four strands—'the reader should feel four clocks raised at once'—the method practiced on the author's side
Letters to a Young Novelist: as critic, systematically punishing exposed and hidden machinery alike, legislating transparency
The intra-chapter fusion of three timelines in The Feast of the Goat: readers may never chart it but feel 'three clocks checking against each other'—perceptible, undecodable
modern_applications_zh: 产品/界面设计：复杂功能'可感而不可解码'——用户感到被安排妥当，说不出机关在哪
课程与演讲设计：写结构意图一句话，请盲测听众复述'这场演讲是怎么组织的'，以复述层次检验透明度
代码审查：架构评审双检'机关外露'（过度设计可见）与'机关全隐'（关键约束无文档）
modern_applications_en: Product and interface design: complexity 'perceptible, undecodable'—users feel things are arranged without locating the machinery
Course and talk design: write the structural intention in one sentence, blind-test listeners on 'how was this talk organized,' judge transparency by the levels named
Code review: check architecture for both exposed machinery (over-engineering visible) and hidden machinery (key constraints undocumented)

representative_figures.relation_zh: 批评传统的先师——'小说是一间亮着灯的房子的批评理想与透明法同源
representative_figures.relation_en: the precursor of the critical tradition—the ideal of the novel as 'a house lit for the reader' shares the root of transparency

representative_figures.relation_en: the exemplar of construction—the fugue's complexity wholly felt, its machinery never exposed; the musical archetype of transparent structure

name_zh: 悬念工艺/信息差驱动叙事：让某个角色比读者（或比其他角色）多知道一点关键信息，泄密的节奏决定阅读的拉力——情节的传动不是靠事件堆叠，而是靠'谁知道什么'的差值变化
name_en: suspense craft/narrative driven by information differentials: let some character know one key thing more than the reader (or than the other characters); the rhythm of the leak sets the pull of reading—plot's transmission is not the stacking of events but the changing difference of 'who knows what'
category: 悬念工艺/信息差驱动叙事：让某个角色比读者（或比其他角色）多知道一点关键信息，泄密的节奏决定阅读的拉力——情节的传动不是靠事件堆叠，而是靠'谁知道什么'的差值变化
modes.domain_zh: 《公羊的节日》把信息差用到结构级：读者从第一章就知道独裁者将死（历史人人皆知），真正的悬念被置换为'他怎么死、谁出卖、谁付出什么'——已知结局迫使悬念全部转移到信息差上：刺客们的互不信任（谁可能招供）、元老们的互相监听、乌拉尼娅知道而读者不知道的家庭真相（她的泄密被延迟到全书三分之二处）。《城市与狗》同理：偷题案的真凶、拍摄演习照片的人、告密者是谁——军校所有人对同一组事实持有不同碎片，泄密次序（演习—挨打—审讯—自白）就是情节。略萨在《给青年小说家的信》中说：'读者不需要知道一切，但必须确信有人知道得更多。'方法要害：信息差必须可消耗（每章泄一点，差值递减），且最后的泄密必须改变读者对已读部分的理解（重估而不只是解答）。
modes.domain_en: The Feast of the Goat uses the differential structurally: from chapter one readers know the dictator will die (history is public), so the true suspense is displaced onto 'how he dies, who betrays, who pays'—the known ending forces all suspense onto information differentials: the assassins' mutual distrust (who might talk), the elders' mutual surveillance, and the family truth Urena knows and the reader does not (her leak held back to two-thirds of the book). The Time of the Hero likewise: who stole the exam, who photographed the exercise, who informed—all in the academy hold different shards of one set of facts, and the order of leaks (exercise—beating—interrogation—confession) is the plot. In Letters to a Young Novelist: 'the reader need not know everything, but must be certain someone knows more.' The crux: differentials must be consumable (a leak each chapter, the gap shrinking) and the final leak must change the reader's understanding of what was already read—revaluation, not merely an answer.
modes.definition_zh: 悬念工艺/信息差驱动叙事：让某个角色比读者（或比其他角色）多知道一点关键信息，泄密的节奏决定阅读的拉力——情节的传动靠'谁知道什么'的差值变化
modes.definition_en: Suspense craft/narrative driven by information differentials: let some character know one key thing more than the reader or the others; the rhythm of the leak sets the pull of reading—plot's transmission is the changing difference of 'who knows what'
modes.source_chapter: 《公羊的节日》（2000）；《城市与狗》（1963）；《给青年小说家的信》论'泄密的艺术'
key_concepts: 信息差 information differential
已知结局的悬念置换 suspense displaced by a known ending
泄密次序即情节 order of leaks as plot
差值可消耗 consumable differentials
重估式泄密 revaluing leaks
modes.key_quote_zh: 读者不必知道一切，但必须确信有人知道得更多。
modes.key_quote_en: The reader need not know everything, but must be certain someone knows more.
process_zh: 开列'知情表'：每个角色对每项关键信息标注'知道/半知/不知'，读者一行单独列出
设计泄密时间表：把差值按章节分配递减——每章至少泄一项，且任何一章泄密量不超过读者消化力
若结局公开（历史题材），把悬念整体置换到'过程与代价'：结局已知，路径与出卖未知
安排'重估点'：最后一次泄密必须迫使读者带着新信息重读已读部分——解答之上还要重估
process_en: Draw a 'knowledge table': mark every character as knowing/half-knowing/not knowing each key fact, with the reader as a separate row
Design a leak schedule: distribute differentials across chapters in decreasing amounts—each chapter leaks at least one item, never more than the reader can digest
If the ending is public (historical material), displace suspense wholly onto 'process and price': the end known, the path and betrayals unknown
Set a 'revaluation point': the final leak must force the reader to reread what came before under new information—answer plus revaluation
representative_cases_zh: 《公羊的节日》：结局已知而悬念全在泄密差值（谁招供/谁监听/乌拉尼娅的家庭真相延迟至三分之二处）——泄密传动法的结构级示范
《城市与狗》：偷题、照片、告密三组信息差在军校人群中分配，泄密次序（演习—挨打—审讯—自白）就是情节本身
《情爱笔记? 实为《继母颂》：继母与少年的欲望互为知情差，父亲'知道得最少'的位置是全书反讽引擎
representative_cases_en: The Feast of the Goat: the ending known, all suspense in leak differentials (who confesses, who surveils, Urena's family truth held to two-thirds)—the structural demonstration

The Time of the Hero: three information gaps (the exam, the photographs, the informing) distributed across the academy; the order of leaks—exercise, beating, interrogation, confession—is the plot itself
In Praise of the Stepmother: the stepmother and the boy hold the differential of desire, the father 'knowing least' as the engine of the book's irony
modern_applications_zh: 危机公关：设计'知情表'与泄密次序——什么先说、什么由谁说、什么保留，差值管理决定舆论拉力
产品发布节奏：把功能差值按月递减泄出（预热—beta—正式），已知愿景、未知路径的悬念置换
团队管理沟通：裁员/重组等已定结局信息，悬念全部转移到'如何执行、谁受影响、什么补偿'的过程透明上
modern_applications_en: Crisis communication: design the knowledge table and the leak order—what first, by whom, what withheld; differential management sets the pull of opinion
Product launch rhythm: leak the feature differential monthly in decreasing amounts (teaser, beta, release)—vision known, path unknown
Management communication: for settled outcomes like layoffs or restructuring, move all suspense onto process transparency—how, whom, what compensation

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——把'谁知道什么'的差值管理写成情节传动的核心工艺
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who made the management of 'who knows what' the core transmission of plot

representative_figures.relation_zh: 电影侧的同构者——'炸弹桌下的观众知情'定理与泄密传动共享同一信息差原理
representative_figures.relation_en: the isomorph in cinema—'the bomb under the table known to the audience' shares the same principle of differential

representative_figures.relation_zh: 古代远源——《史记》列传以知情差安排材料出场（谁先知道、谁被瞒住），史传叙事的泄密工艺源头
representative_figures.relation_en: the ancient distant source—the Shiji biographies arrange material by differential (who learns first, who is kept dark), the fountainhead of leak craft in historical narrative

name_zh: 思想演化方法论/公开记录并论证自己的思想迁移：从左翼到古典自由主义不是'变节'而是'把每一步检验过的错误逐条公开清算'——立场的可信度来自迁移过程的可审计性
name_en: methodology of intellectual evolution/record and argue one's own conversion in public: from the left to classical liberalism not as 'betrayal' but as 'an itemized public settlement of every tested error'—the credibility of a position drawn from the auditability of its migration
category: 思想演化方法论/公开记录并论证自己的思想迁移：从左翼到古典自由主义不是'变节'而是'把每一步检验过的错误逐条公开清算'——立场的可信度来自迁移过程的可审计性
modes.domain_zh: 略萨是二十世纪公开清算自己政治履历最彻底的作家之一。他 1950 年代在圣马科斯信奉马克思主义、支持古巴革命；1971 年因帕迪利亚事件公开与卡斯特罗决裂；此后数十年在《水中鱼》（1993）等文本里逐条清算：为何曾经相信计划经济、哪次经验推翻了它（首要的是他对秘鲁国有化与集体农庄的实地观察、以及对苏联式制度的文献研究）、自由主义在他的体系里补上了哪块（个人自由、法治、市场作为信息机制）。关键在于他的清算方式：不是宣布'我以前是傻瓜'，而是把旧立场的内部逻辑完整复述出来、再指出它在哪一环与经验冲突——迁移因此成为可审计的论证而非情绪的转身。代价与极限：清算的彻底性有时过度（对左翼的全盘否定抹去了其真实成就）；且公开迁移的作家容易被新旧两个阵营同时质疑；晚年他承认把文学判断与政治立场挂钩是其批评工作的污染源。
modes.domain_en: Vargas Llosa was among the most thorough twentieth-century writers in publicly settling his own political record. A Marxist at San Marcos in the 1950s and a supporter of the Cuban revolution, he broke publicly with Castro over the Padilla affair in 1971; over the following decades, in A Fish in the Water (1993) and elsewhere, he settled accounts item by item: why he had believed in the planned economy, which experience overthrew it (above all his field observation of Peruvian nationalization and collective farms, and his documentary study of the Soviet-type system), and what liberalism supplied in the gap (individual liberty, the rule of law, the market as an information mechanism). The key is the manner: not announcing 'I was once a fool,' but restating the old position's internal logic completely and then showing where it collided with experience—conversion thus becoming an auditable argument, not an emotional turn. Costs and limits: thoroughness sometimes tipped into excess (blanket repudiation of the left erasing its real achievements); the publicly converted writer is distrusted by both camps at once; late in life he conceded that binding literary judgment to political position had been a contaminant of his criticism.
modes.definition_zh: 思想演化方法论/公开记录并论证自己的思想迁移：立场转变以'逐条公开清算检验过的错误'完成——立场的可信度来自迁移过程的可审计性
modes.definition_en: Methodology of intellectual evolution/record and argue one's own conversion in public: the change of position completed as 'an itemized public settlement of every tested error'—credibility drawn from the auditability of the migration
modes.source_chapter: 回忆录《水中鱼》（1993，竞选与思想迁移双重记述）；1971 年帕迪利亚事件公开信；政论集《自由生活》（La tentacion de la imposible）；2010 诺贝尔演说论自由
key_concepts: 可审计的迁移 auditable migration
逐条清算 itemized settlement
旧逻辑完整复述 restating the old logic whole
经验否证点 the point of empirical refutation
双阵营质疑 distrust from both camps
modes.key_quote_zh: 我改变立场，不是换旗帜，是把旧旗的每一道裂缝指给人看。
modes.key_quote_en: I changed my position not by swapping flags but by pointing out every tear in the old one.
process_zh: 立场变更前先完成'旧立场的内部复述'：能比旧同道更准确地讲清旧逻辑，才有资格批评它
定位'经验否证点'：找出使旧逻辑与事实冲突的具体经验（一次实地、一份文献、一次失败），公开写明
以'逐条清算'代替'宣言转身'：把旧立场的每个支柱逐条检验并公布结论——允许部分保留，不许全盘涂抹
接受双阵营质疑并留档回应：把新旧双方的批评收集成档，逐条回应——迁移的可信度在被质疑中完成闭环
process_en: Before changing position, complete an internal restatement of the old: only one who can state the old logic more accurately than its partisans has standing to criticize it
Locate the point of empirical refutation: the concrete experience (a field visit, a document, a failure) where the old logic met contradiction, stated publicly
Replace the manifesto-turn with itemized settlement: test each pillar of the old position and publish the result—partial retention allowed, whitewash forbidden
Accept cross-camp challenge and archive the replies: collect criticism from both sides and answer item by item—the conversion's credibility closes its loop under challenge
representative_cases_zh: 《水中鱼》：把 1990 年竞选与三十年思想迁移写成双重记述，旧马克思主义逻辑被完整复述后再逐条否证——自由迁移法的自传级示范
1971 年帕迪利亚公开信：以'捍卫革命中的作家'起笔、以与卡斯特罗决裂收束——公开迁移的第一份档案
《给青年小说家的信》与后期政论：把'自由是小说的存在条件'论证成体系——迁移不只在政治层完成，也在美学层完成
representative_cases_en: A Fish in the Water: the 1990 campaign and thirty years of migration as a double account, the old Marxist logic restated whole before itemized refutation—the autobiographical demonstration
The Padilla letter of 1971: opening as 'defense of the writer within the revolution,' closing in rupture with Castro—the first archive of the public migration
Letters to a Young Novelist and late polemics: 'liberty as the condition of the novel' argued into a system—the migration completed at the aesthetic as well as the political level
modern_applications_zh: 技术选型迁移：团队从旧架构迁出时先做'旧架构内部复述'与'经验否证点'文档，逐条迁移而非宣言式重写
学者/分析师换立场：公开写清'我曾为何相信 X、哪份数据推翻了它'——可审计的转向比沉默转向更可信
组织变革沟通：把旧制度的支柱逐条公开检验（哪些保留、哪些废弃、依据什么经验），替代一刀切的宣布
modern_applications_en: Technology-stack migration: before leaving an old architecture, write the 'internal restatement' and 'empirical refutation point' documents; migrate item by item, not by manifesto rewrite
Analysts changing position: publish 'why I believed X and which data overthrew it'—an auditable turn is more credible than a silent one
Organizational change communication: publicly test each pillar of the old system (what is kept, what is scrapped, on what experience) instead of a blanket announcement

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——把思想迁移写成可审计论证的第一人
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—the writer who turned intellectual migration into an auditable argument

representative_figures.relation_zh: 同路先师——《向加泰罗尼亚致敬》以亲身经验否证党派叙事，是'经验否证点'的先例
representative_figures.relation_en: the precursor on the same road—Homage to Catalonia refuting party narrative with personal experience, the precedent of the empirical refutation point

representative_figures.relation_zh: 东方平行——'不惜以今日之我攻昨日之我'的公开自我修订，与自由迁移法共享同一迁移伦理
representative_figures.relation_en: the Eastern parallel—'fearlessly attacking yesterday's self with today's' in public revision, sharing the same ethic of migration

name_zh: 收束工艺/多线、多时序、多信息差的总收束：在结尾把此前分散的声部、时序与真相同时合拢，让读者发现所有线索早已在同一结构里——收束不是结局，是结构的显影
name_en: craft of closure/the grand gathering of multiple lines, chronologies and information differentials: at the end, dispersed voices, times and truths close simultaneously, and the reader discovers all threads were already inside one structure—closure is not an ending but the developing of the structure
category: 收束工艺/多线、多时序、多信息差的总收束：在结尾把此前分散的声部、时序与真相同时合拢，让读者发现所有线索早已在同一结构里——收束不是结局，是结构的显影
modes.domain_zh: 略萨小说的结尾几乎从不提供'新事件'，而是提供'显影液'。《绿房子》终章：四条线的结尾并置合流，鲍妮法西娅站在绿房子前——读者此刻才看清四条线是同一台绞肉机的四个进料口，此前的一切并置瞬间获得单线阅读不可能有的重量。《公羊的节日》：三条时间线（刺杀日、垂死六小时、乌拉尼娅的回忆）在结尾互锁——乌拉尼娅的泄密改变了对独裁者之死的理解，独裁者之死又反过来定义了她一生创伤的意义。《城市与狗》以'美洲豹'的自白收束：最后一章的泄密使全书所有并置的碎片显影为一张完整底片。方法要害：显影必须'早已在场'——终章揭示的信息必须在前面各线中都有痕迹（可回查），收束因此是结构的自证而非外加的翻转；且合拢要同时完成（多线在同一段落内互锁），不能排队收束。
modes.domain_en: The endings of Vargas Llosa's novels almost never supply a 'new event' but a 'developer.' The Green House's final chapter: the four strands set side by side and merged, Bonifacia standing before the green house—and only now the reader sees the four were intakes of one mill, all previous juxtaposition instantly taking on weight no single-line reading could give. The Feast of the Goat: the three timelines (assassination day, six dying hours, Urena's memory) interlock at the end—her leak changes the understanding of the dictator's death, and his death defines the meaning of her lifelong trauma. The Time of the Hero closes with the Jaguar's confession: the last chapter's leak develops all the scattered shards into one complete negative. The crux: the developing must 'have been there all along'—what the final chapter reveals must already be traceable in every earlier strand, so closure is the structure's self-verification, not a bolted-on twist; and the gathering must be simultaneous (interlocking within one passage), not queued.
modes.definition_zh: 收束工艺/多线、多时序、多信息差的总收束：结尾把分散的声部、时序与真相同时合拢，让读者发现所有线索早已在同一结构里——收束不是结局，是结构的显影
modes.definition_en: Craft of closure/the grand gathering of multiple lines, chronologies and information differentials: dispersed voices, times and truths close simultaneously at the end, and the reader discovers all threads were already inside one structure—closure is the developing of the structure, not an ending
modes.source_chapter: 《绿房子》（1966）终章结构分析；《城市与狗》（1963）终章自白；《公羊的节日》（2000）三线互锁结尾；《给青年小说家的信》论结尾
key_concepts: 显影液结尾 the developer ending
早已在场 already present
同时合拢 simultaneous gathering
结构的自证 the structure's self-verification
重估式收束 revaluing closure
modes.key_quote_zh: 好的结尾不给新事件，给显影液。
modes.key_quote_en: A good ending gives no new event; it gives developer.
process_zh: 写初稿前先写'终章显影清单'：列出结尾必须合拢的每一条线、每一处时序、每一项信息差——收束目标先于写作
在每条线内部预埋'显影痕迹'：终章将揭示的信息在前面各线至少留两处可回查的痕迹
收束段执行'同时合拢'：多线、多时序、多泄密在同一段落内互锁，不许排队解释
终检两项：终章无'新事件'（只显影不添加）；把终章删去重读前文——若前文因此失去意义则显影失败，重做
process_en: Before drafting, write the final-chapter 'developer list': every line, chronology and information gap the ending must gather—the goal of closure precedes the writing
Bury 'developing traces' inside each strand: what the final chapter reveals must leave at least two checkable marks earlier in every relevant line
In the closing passage, gather simultaneously: multiple lines, times and leaks interlocking within one passage—no queuing of explanations
Final test, two items: the final chapter contains no new event (only developing, no adding); delete the final chapter and reread—if the rest loses meaning, the developing failed, redo it
representative_cases_zh: 《绿房子》终章：四线合流于绿房子前的鲍妮法西娅，'四个进料口、一台绞肉机'的结构显影——迷宫收束法的建筑级示范
《城市与狗》终章：'美洲豹'自白使全部碎片显影为完整底片——重估式收束的教科书
《公羊的节日》结尾：三时间线互锁，乌拉尼娅的泄密与独裁者之死互为定义——同时合拢的当代范本
representative_cases_en: The Green House's final chapter: four strands merging on Bonifacia before the green house—'four intakes, one mill' developed as structure, the architectural demonstration
